chapter.title: Overview
chapter.para: This specification defines the SIP-related operations for ONVIF compliant devices. It covers SIP server configuration, NAT traversal configuration, and call management.
The WSDL for this service is defined at: http://www.onvif.org/ver10/sip/wsdl

section.title: GetServiceCapabilities
section.para: This command returns the capabilities of the SIP service.

listitem.para: The capability response message contains the requested SIP service capabilities.

table.title: The capabilities in the GetServiceCapabilities command

entry.para: Indicates the maximum number of server configurations supported.
Indicates the maximum number of SIP registrars supported per server configuration.
Indicates the maximum number of STUN server URIs supported per server configuration.
Indicates the maximum number of TURN servers supported per server configuration.
Indicates if the device supports call buttons.

section.title: SIP Server Configuration
section.para: A device indicating SIP capabilities shall support the CreateServerConfiguration, DeleteServerConfiguration, GetServerConfigurations and SetServerConfiguration commands. The maximum number of server configurations supported is indicated by the MaximumServerConfigurations SIP capability. The maximum number of registrars per server configuration is indicated by the MaximumRegistrars SIP capability.
A server configuration consists of the following fields:

listitem.para: One or more SIP registrar entries. Each entry contains a Uri and a Transport field. The Transport field specifies the transport protocol to use for the registrar and shall be one of: UDP, TCP, or TLS.
The user info/extension of the Address of Record (AoR) in SIP, identifying the device on the registrar.

Optional. The unique identifier of the certification path validation policy to be used for validating the server certificate as declared in the security service. If not configured, server certificate validation behavior is undefined and the device may either apply a vendor specific default validation policy or skip validation at all.

Authentication configuration. Either Credential (UserName and Password) or AuthorizationServer may be provided. Credential contains the username and password used to authenticate with the SIP server. AuthorizationServer is a reference token referring to the server that provides access tokens to authorize with the renewal endpoint as defined in the Security specification.
Optional name of the server configuration.

section.title: CreateServerConfiguration
section.para: This operation creates a new SIP server configuration on the device.

listitem.para: The new server configuration to be added on the device.
Token of the created server configuration.
The device cannot create a new server configuration because it already has the maximum number of server configurations that it supports.
The number of registrars exceeds the maximum number supported by the device.
The URI set in a registrar is not valid.
No AuthorizationServer exists for the specified token.
Cannot have both AuthorizationServer and Credential configured at the same time. Only one may be provided.
No certification path validation policy exists under the requested CertPathValidationPolicyID.

section.title: DeleteServerConfiguration
section.para: This operation deletes an existing SIP server configuration from the device. Deleting a server configuration removes all other configuration types that reference this configuration.

listitem.para: Token of the server configuration to delete.
The Token does not reference an existing server configuration.

section.title: GetServerConfigurations
section.para: This operation gets the SIP server configuration(s) of the device. The device shall support this command. The device shall not return the password in the response.

listitem.para: Optional token of the requested server configuration. If omitted, all server configurations are returned.
The SIP server configuration(s) of the device, each paired with its Token.
The Token does not reference an existing server configuration.

section.title: SetServerConfiguration
section.para: This operation sets the SIP server configuration of the device. The device shall support this command. The number of registrars shall not exceed the value indicated by the MaximumRegistrars SIP capability.

listitem.para: The SIP server configuration to update on the device.
The Token does not reference an existing server configuration.
The number of registrars exceeds the maximum number supported by the device.
The URI set in a registrar is not valid.
No AuthorizationServer exists for the specified token.
Cannot have both AuthorizationServer and Credential configured at the same time. Only one may be provided.
No certification path validation policy exists under the requested CertPathValidationPolicyID.

section.title: NAT Configuration
section.para: A device indicating MaximumStunServers > 0 or MaximumTurnServers > 0 in the SIP capabilities shall support the GetNatConfigurations and SetNatConfiguration commands. Only one NAT configuration is supported per server configuration. The maximum number of STUN server URIs is indicated by the MaximumStunServers SIP capability and the maximum number of TURN servers is indicated by the MaximumTurnServers SIP capability.
The NAT configuration consists of the following fields:

listitem.para: Token of the server configuration that this NAT configuration applies to.
Optional. Contains one or more STUN server URIs used for NAT traversal.

Optional, unbounded. Each entry contains one or more TURN server URIs and optional credentials (UserName and Password) used to authenticate with the TURN server. The device shall not return the password in the response.

section.title: GetNatConfigurations
section.para: This operation gets the NAT configurations of the device. There shall be 1 configuration per ServerConfiguration token. The device shall not return TURN server passwords in the response.

listitem.para: Optional token to filter configurations based on server configuration token.
The NAT configurations of the device. Maximum 1 per ServerConfiguration token.
The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.

section.title: SetNatConfiguration
section.para: This operation updates a NAT configuration of the device based on the ServerConfiguration token. The number of STUN server URIs shall not exceed the value indicated by the MaximumStunServers SIP capability. The number of TURN servers shall not exceed the value indicated by the MaximumTurnServers SIP capability.

listitem.para: The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.
The number of STUN server URIs exceeds the maximum number supported by the device.
The number of TURN servers exceeds the maximum number supported by the device.

section.title: Call Configuration
section.para: A device indicating SIP capabilities shall support the GetCallConfigurations and SetCallConfiguration commands. Shall contain 1 call configuration per ServerConfiguration.
A call configuration consists of the following fields:

listitem.para: Token of the server configuration that this call configuration applies to.
Indicates whether the device shall allow incoming calls.
Indicates whether the device shall automatically answer incoming calls.

section.title: GetCallConfigurations
section.para: This operation gets the call configurations of the device.

listitem.para: The matching ServerConfiguration token for the call configuration.
One or all call configurations of the device.
The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.

section.title: SetCallConfiguration
section.para: This operation sets the call configuration of the device.

listitem.para: The call configuration to set on the device.
The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.

section.title: Call Buttons
section.para: A device indicating the CallButtons SIP capability shall support the GetCallButtons, SetCallButtons and GetCallButtonOptions commands. Shall contain 1 button configuration per ServerConfiguration.
A call button consists of the following fields:

listitem.para: Display name of the call recipient.
The user info/extension of the Address of Record (AoR) in SIP, identifying the recipient on the registrar.
Optional attribute indicating whether this button is enabled or not. Defaults to true.

section.title: GetCallButtons
section.para: This operation gets the call button configurations of the device. This method is optional. It shall be available if the CallButtons capability is TRUE.

listitem.para: The matching ServerConfiguration token for the button configuration.
A button configuration of the device.
The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.
This optional method is not implemented.

section.title: SetCallButtons
section.para: This operation sets the call button configuration of the device. This method is optional. It shall be available if the CallButtons capability is TRUE.

listitem.para: The button configuration to set on the device.
The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.
The ButtonId does not reference a supported physical, relay or virtual button.
This optional method is not implemented.

section.title: GetCallButtonOptions
section.para: This operation gets the list of supported physical, relay and virtual call button identifiers of the device. This method is optional. It shall be available if the CallButtons capability is TRUE.

listitem.para: List of virtual button ids. Example for a touchscreen interface.
This optional method is not implemented.

section.title: SIP Streaming Configuration
section.para: The SIP streaming configuration defines the media configurations used during SIP-based streaming sessions. It allows a client to update the provided configurations used when the device participates in a SIP call.

Shall support a streaming configuration per ServerConfiguration. The SIP streaming configuration determines the media parameters applied during incoming or outgoing SIP sessions. A configuration shall be provided per configuration type that the device supports for SIP streaming. For example, if the device supports both video and audio streaming over SIP, the SIP streaming configuration shall include a video source configuration, a video encoder configuration, an audio source configuration and an audio encoder configuration. If the device supports only audio output (such as a speaker device), then the configuration shall only include the audio output configuration and audio decoder configuration.
The SIP streaming configuration consists of the following fields:

listitem.para: The ServerConfiguration token for the streaming configuration to be modified.
Optional. Video source configuration used for the SIP session.
Optional. Video encoder configuration used for the SIP session.
Optional. Audio source configuration used for the SIP session.
Optional. Audio encoder configuration used for the SIP session.
Optional. Audio output configuration used for the SIP session.
Optional. Audio decoder configuration used for the SIP session.

section.title: GetStreamingConfigurations
section.para: This operation gets the SIP streaming configurations of the device.

listitem.para: The matching ServerConfiguration token for the streaming configuration.
The current SIP streaming configuration(s) of the device.
The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.

section.title: SetStreamingConfiguration
section.para: This operation sets the SIP streaming configuration of the device.

listitem.para: The SIP streaming configuration to set on the device.
The ServerConfiguration token does not reference an existing server configuration.

section.title: GetStreamingConfigurationOptions
section.para: This operation gets the supported options for SIP streaming configuration of the device.

listitem.para: The supported options for SIP streaming configuration.
